name: Element Zero / 零号元素
description:
零号元素是 Agent Periodic Lab（BUILD-100）发给早期把卡存入反应堆的玩家的一张卡。总量上限 100 张，每个地址最多发放 1 张。可以自由转让，也可以在网站的零号元素市场用 BNB 挂单买卖。兑换功能暂未开放。

Element Zero is a card that Agent Periodic Lab (BUILD-100) granted to early players who put cards in the Reactor. At most 100 cards in total, and at most 1 granted per address. It can be transferred freely and traded for BNB on the Element Zero market on the website. Redemption is not open yet.
